# sendgrid_custom_field (Data Source)

Retrieves an existing SendGrid Marketing Campaigns custom field definition by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sendgrid_custom_field" "shoe_size" {
  id = "w1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The custom field's ID.

### Read-Only

- `field_type` (String) The field's data type: `Text`, `Number`, or `Date`.
- `name` (String) The field name.
